biggest_catch: Rover officially confirms payout timing — 2 days after service to your Rover account, up to 5 business days to your bank — but the sitter sets their own rates, so there is no concrete official payout amount.
catches: Official: payments 'ready for withdrawal two days after you have completed a service'; up to 5 business days to reach your bank.
Rover takes a 15% service fee (you keep 85%).
Rates are sitter-set; Rover makes no official per-service pay promise.
Mostly over-25 bookings (boarding) take days to complete; dog walks are shorter but still pay out on the 2-day+ schedule.
